work_identified: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma na ro mkha' spyod ma'i lam gyi rim pa'i spyi don gsang chen sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig — a Gelug scholastic commentary on the general meaning (spyi don) of the two-stage (generation + completion) Vajrayoginī Naro Khecharī practice, composed by Lobzang Tenpai Gyaltsen / Tagpu (blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan, 1714–1762), held in the Ogyen Choling Collection. Distinct from Pabongkha's 'Extremely Secret Dakini of Naropa' and other Naro Khecharī sadhanas.
